name: sabai
description: Pixel-art band above the prompt: folder, git and node; task progress with Clawd and his moods; a crew of subagents; context, 5H and 7D usage; a toolbar. An agents panel with reports, and a settings panel with ten skins, bar styles, alerts and an optional guard with per-rule Block / Ask. In the conversation: tool calls as one-line steps, test results, callout boxes, Thai spinner words and a receipt at the end of each working turn.
